qualifications: All outcomes are original once-run R0 development evidence; source correction is a separate cohort. No independent semantic rating, unseen evaluation or statistical superiority.
Current source support at correction boundary and final revised head support are separate: a later writer repair cannot erase an unsupported intermediate revision.
Correct current/former answer from raw leaves does not pass original-card maintenance when changed claims cite contradictory old sources.
Historical legacy_query_v1 old-target arm may resolve a latest unique target under its disclosed old contract; this is a control, not read-time CAS promotion.
Redundant same-card revisions and paid writer calls remain in history/accounting. One truthful question-episode append is reported separately from duplicate preference cards.
